name: Libya–Egypt Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: Fails add-threshold leg (b) country+region/endpoints (and arguably leg a, dedicated sponsor). No Egypt–Libya gas interconnector concept has fixed endpoints, route, or capacity. The Jan 2026 Petrojet–NOC MoU is a broad oil/gas/mining cooperation framework that only 'explores the feasibility of transporting crude oil and natural gas between the two countries' — a study-level intent, not a pipeline project with a sponsor, defined corridor, or physical scope.
researcher_notes: Re-checked match-to-existing against all 57 Egypt gas rows in discovery_context.json: no Libya–Egypt (or Salloum/Tobruk/Libya-border) gas interconnector exists in GGIT — confirmed genuine absence, not a matched row. CONFIRMED the Jan 25 2026 Petrojet–NOC MoU signed at the Libya Energy & Economic Summit in Tripoli (signatories Waleed Lotfy, PETROJET chairman; Masoud Suleman, NOC chairman) via two independent English sources: egyptoil-gas.com and logupdateafrica.com (both verified 200 + content; Egypt State Information Service sis.gov.eg corroborates in search results but its URL failed url_verifier on SSLError, not cited). All independent accounts agree the MoU spans oil, gas AND mining and only commits to STUDYING feasibility of moving crude and gas between the countries — no gas-pipeline sponsor, no route, no endpoints, no capacity, no length. This is a recurring cross-border project family with a long non-delivery record: 1997 Tobruk–Sidi Krir crude plan and 2000 ~$100m Altube JV (crude to Egypt / Egyptian gas to Libya) never built (egyptoil-gas 2019 feature, verified); Nov 2022 NOC chairman Bengdara at ADIPEC floated a Libya→Damietta gas export line alongside a Greece line and Greenstream (pipeline-journal, verified) — a Libya-export study, distinct from and not carried forward into the 2026 MoU. Confidence tier medium: the 2026 MoU itself is well-corroborated (2+ independent), but the underlying pipeline remains pre-feasibility with no physical scope. Recommend MONITOR — revisit if a dedicated gas-interconnector feasibility study, FEED, defined route/endpoints, or capacity is announced.
